_comment: Which game viewers this application serves, and the release each comes from.
This used to be resolved through devops/games/registry.toml and a sibling checkout of the
cartridge's repository, which made devops part of this application's build. A cartridge now
publishes its build output as a GitHub release -- one archive, laid out as its dist/ -- so the
coordinate is a repository and nothing outside this directory is read. The latest release is
taken unless the variable named by `env` names a tag, or a directory laid out as that dist/.
The Dockerfile fetches each release in a pair of stages, because a Dockerfile cannot loop; a
second game is an entry here AND those stages there. scripts/vendor-viewers.sh reads this file alone.
